title: The Enterprise AI Accountability Framework
excerpt: The accounting plane for enterprise AI. Introduces the Token Detail Record (TDR), the heir to telecom's Call Detail Record, and the Proxy of Record (POR): an independent, per-event, rated ledger of AI consumption you can reconcile against the vendor invoice, govern, and prove.

title: The Agent Control Plane
excerpt: The signaling plane for enterprise AI. Treats dispersed specialized agents as a network, not a function call, and adapts telecom's control and data plane split (ASP, ALS, ABC, Agent Bearer, SigMod) to establish, route, negotiate, and govern agent sessions.
